name: Focus mode
oneLiner: glass notifications pile in faster and faster, a fingertip flips the Focus toggle on, the whole pile folds up silently into one small quiet pill with a count, and a late ping drops in and is swallowed by it without a sound
say: when the speaker talks about cutting out distractions ('I turn everything off', 'no pings while I work'): the pile builds under the problem, the toggle flips on 'focus' or 'off' and the pile folds away into the quiet pill. Set lines, apps and the mode label
